tag_rules_note: Generic starter keywords for the bootstrap tagger: case-insensitive substrings of the asset path, checked in declared order (first match wins), 'hero' is never auto-assigned. Short keywords can false-positive - read the dry-run's UNMATCHED section and each tier's list before applying. A project should replace these with its own in <Project>/Saved/BudgetGuard/config.json (see examples/).

rule_catalog.label: Texture resolution over budget
rule_catalog.description: Largest side above the tier's max_texture_resolution (WARN; FAIL past severe_multiplier).

rule_catalog.label: sRGB on normal map
rule_catalog.description: A normal map must not be sampled as sRGB.

rule_catalog.label: Texture group unassigned
rule_catalog.description: Texture still on an engine-default group instead of its tier's group.

rule_catalog.label: Triangles over budget
rule_catalog.description: LOD0 triangles above the tier's max_triangles (FAIL past severe_multiplier).

rule_catalog.label: Missing LOD
rule_catalog.description: Mesh above missing_lod_triangle_threshold with a single LOD.

rule_catalog.label: Nanite enabled
rule_catalog.description: Nanite is unsupported on Quest 3 standalone.

rule_catalog.label: Complex-as-simple collision
rule_catalog.description: Collision uses render geometry instead of simple shapes.

rule_catalog.label: Translucent material
rule_catalog.description: Translucency is overdraw-heavy on mobile VR.

rule_catalog.label: Two-sided material
rule_catalog.description: Two-sided doubles shading cost on mobile VR.
